description: Returns top-N institutional holders of a US public company at a specific period_end (by default the latest period whose 45-day 13F filing window has closed), with aggregate institutional shares, total market value, holder count, and HHI concentration (sum of squared share-of-total percentages) over EVERY common-stock 13F holder of that period, not only the returned top-N rows.  Sourced from Form 13F-HR via the by-issuer partition.  Institutional plan only.  A newer quarter still inside its filing window is incomplete: it is skipped by default (named in newer_period_in_filing_window) and flagged by filing_window_open when requested explicitly.  staleness_warning fires when the latest data is older than 90 days.

as_of_date.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD): only 13F filings ACCEPTED by SEC on or before this date are considered, applied BEFORE the latest period is resolved. A 13F/A amendment or late filing accepted after this date is excluded (zero look-ahead) — use this for survivorship-free backtests. Omit for the latest knowable book.

include_superseded.description: Default false: 13F-HR rows replaced by a later 13F-HR/A are hidden once the amendment is knowable (as of as_of_date when given), so an original and its amendment are never both counted. Set true to include the superseded originals.

lineage_detail.description: Per-row provenance envelope. compact / full / off.

period_end.description: Quarter-end of the 13F reporting period (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit to use the latest period available. This is a REPORTING period, NOT a point-in-time cutoff — use as_of_date for that.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol of the issuer — or a CIK (SEC identifier).

top_n.description: Maximum holders to return, ranked by market_value_usd. Default 25, max 200.

name: get_institutional_holdings

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

has_incomplete_rows.description: True when ≥1 included holder reported a null shares/market_value — the totals sum only known values and UNDERSTATE the true figure (missing ≠ zero).

is_partial.description: Whether the totals were cut by top_n. Always false: total_institutional_shares, total_market_value_usd and hhi_concentration cover every holder in the period; only rows[] is capped.

as_of_date.description: The point-in-time cutoff actually applied (echo of the as_of_date input). Null when no PIT cut was requested — never confuse this with the reporting period_end.

filing_deadline.description: Last on-time 13F filing day for period_end (45 days after quarter end, past a weekend).

filing_window_open.description: True when period_end is still inside its 13F filing window (through filing_deadline): managers that have not filed yet are missing, so totals, HHI and ranks are incomplete.

metrics_display.description: total_institutional_shares, total_market_value_usd and hhi_concentration rendered for prose ('3.18B shares', '$808.01B', '399.67'). QUOTE THESE VERBATIM.

newer_period_in_filing_window.description: A newer period with early filings that was skipped because its filing window is still open. Pass it as period_end to read that partial book.

options_positions_count.description: Option positions (put_call set) excluded from totals/HHI/rows. rows[] are common-stock 13F holdings only.

period_end.description: The 13F REPORTING period the rows belong to — NOT a point-in-time cutoff.

metrics_display.description: This holder's shares and market value rendered for prose. QUOTE THESE VERBATIM.

title: Institutional Holdings (by issuer)
